in_sanskrit.name: Dinu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Day, Light

In Hindu mythology, Dinu is believed to represent the divine force of light and wisdom. It is a name of spiritual significance and is often given to children as a symbol of hope, enlightenment, and knowledge.
